text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After she suffers an injury, I hurriedly escort Seeking the Pearl to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you don't need to be so worried.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course, I know you must feel impatient. That's just proof of how much you care about achieving our dream.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Why don't you observe me while I do a light jog? If we can figure out how far I can push myself, it'll be easier to put together a recovery plan for me.
choice_data_list: No, I don't want you to strain yourself.
…All right. Let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh… Well, I get where you're coming from.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In that case, you'd better get ready for the new and improved me! When I'm back on my feet again, I'll be shining like a dazzling pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Let's head to the racetrack, then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Whew… There's not going to be much I can do if even this level of exertion hurts…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It probably won't be safe if I try push myself any further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Seeking the Pearl decides to rest until her injury is fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I can run without any issues. My recovery should be smooth sailing at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: As long as I don't lose hope, I'll keep on shining evermore!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That is my answer to your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl manages to recover without issue thanks to her strength of will.
